key_catalyst: US-Iran diplomatic talks stall and military strikes continue, driving Brent crude above $93 and pushing the 10-year Treasury yield back to 4.62%.
reasoning: The escalation of the US-Iran conflict, marked by stalled diplomacy and continued military strikes, has driven oil above $93 and pushed the 10-year yield back to 4.62%, completely reversing the prior session's yield-driven relief rally. This resurgence of inflation fears, combined with heavy profit-taking in semiconductors and broad de-risking ahead of pivotal Alphabet and Tesla earnings, creates a high-risk environment that favors selling.
